name: Dr Mit Ring®
tagline: The condom fastener from Dr. Ismail Tambi

definition.summary: Dr Mit Ring® is a reusable silicone condom fastener (alat penahan kondom). It is slipped on after a condom is in place and keeps the condom from slipping. It was developed by andrologist Dr. Ismail Tambi and is sold through SuamiSihat channels.

facts.label: What it is
facts.value: Rounded silicone ring, indented inner wall at the base and thicker upper edge (per pack)

facts.label: Reuse
facts.value: Up to 3 to 5 uses depending on use (per pack)

facts.label: Care
facts.value: Rinse under running water, do not soak, dry with a clean towel, store in a clean dry container

range.name: Dr Mit Ring® (2 rings)
range.desc: Retail box with two reusable rings and bilingual instructions.

definition.claimsReview: The pack lists benefits (longer erection, preventing venous leakage, delaying premature ejaculation) and badges such as 'Andrologically tested'. Earlier repo copy also called it a 'patented' ED device with sterilisation and wear-time specs that are not on the pack. All benefit claims must be checked against the device's registration status before use in marketing. Lead with what it is: a condom fastener.

positioning.statement: For couples who want protection that stays put, Dr Mit Ring® is the simple, drug-free condom fastener from Dr. Ismail Tambi's andrology practice, discreet, reusable and easy to care for.

pillars.title: Doctor-developed
pillars.text: Created by Dr. Ismail Tambi. Lead with his expertise, stated factually.

pillars.title: Simple and drug-free
pillars.text: A physical accessory: no pills, nothing to swallow. Explain how to use it in plain steps.

pillars.title: Discreet confidence
pillars.text: Calm, respectful tone. Clinical green, clean diagrams, no explicit imagery.

voice: Instructional: short steps, clear care advice
Respectful of couples; inclusive of both partners
avoid: Treatment or cure language for erectile dysfunction or premature ejaculation
Unverified badges or words such as 'patented', 'certified' or 'clinically proven'
Explicit or suggestive imagery; use the hand silhouette and line drawings

colorScheme.note: On the packaging, small white text sits on green. For new artwork use Neutral Black for anything under 24 px; white is allowed only for large headings on Deep Green. Use Green Text #1A7F33 when green type is needed on white.

pattern.name: Ring Ripple
pattern.description: Offset concentric rings in Lime and Deep Green with a soft black halo on Dr Mit Green, abstracted from the ring's shape.
usage: Use as a background on green panels, banners and box sides
Keep text on a solid green or black panel, not directly on the rings
Do not rotate, recolour or crop the rings into the logo badge
One pattern area per layout, at most a third of the surface

logos.label: Dr Mit Ring wordmark
logos.use: White lowercase wordmark; place on Neutral Black or Deep Green

guideline.clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to the cap height of the wordmark on every side. Nothing (text, edges, other logos) enters this zone.
guideline.minimumSize: Digital 120 px wide; print 30 mm wide
do: Show the wordmark white on its black rounded badge or on Deep Green
Use the line-drawing instructions style from the inner panel for how-to content
Keep the 2-rings badge in Signal Yellow with black text
dont: Do not place the white wordmark on Lime or Canvas White
Do not use photography that is explicit or shows anatomy
Do not add claims or certification badges that are not approved
Do not recolour the ring green outside the palette

typography.display: Poppins SemiBold / Bold (SuamiSihat master display face)
typography.body: Inter Regular / Medium for UI and long copy
typography.note: Never retype a wordmark; always place the supplied logo file.

guideline.photography: Product-only or packaging shots on Canvas White or green. Instructional line drawings for usage.
